architecture.locationStores: Avenue H and Avenue I are independent WordPress and WooCommerce installations; no WordPress Multisite
architecture.theme: Reusable Empire King theme; this repository is the Avenue H implementation
architecture.commerce: Each site owns its own WooCommerce database, cart, session, orders, payments, and operational tablet
architecture.durableBusinessLogic: empire-king-deals plugin owns private Deal records/categories, scheduling, eligibility, featured selection, and owner access
architecture.avenueHOrdering: All Avenue H ordering links route locally to /order-now/; there is no shared Avenue H/Avenue I order selector or cross-store cart/session/order/payment routing

seo.strategicDestinations: Home, /deals/, and /order-now/ are indexable, location-specific landing pages
seo.orderNowCanonical: /order-now/ filter and product state parameters consolidate canonically to the clean /order-now/ URL
seo.woocommerceExclusions: Woo product singles and product_cat archives are noindex/follow and excluded from WordPress XML sitemaps; a separate Shop page is noindex/follow
seo.transactionalPages: Cart, checkout, account, and order-received destinations are noindex/follow
seo.restaurantSchema: Home emits location-specific Restaurant structured data from each installation's configured location values
seo.locationOwnership: Avenue H and Avenue I remain independent and never use cross-domain canonicals
seo.deals: /deals/ is the sole permanent indexable Deals landing page; private Deal singles, category archives, and sitemap entries remain disabled

included: private Deals management plugin and public /deals/ landing page

locationRouting.status: Avenue H Order Now links route locally to /order-now/; Deal category targeting and allowlisted campaign parameters are rendered into local URLs

mediaArchitecture.productAndOperationalMedia: CMS-managed WordPress/WooCommerce media; do not hardcode production uploads
mediaArchitecture.temporaryPlaceholders: Clearly identify any temporary development placeholder when one is introduced
mediaArchitecture.mediaCounts: Not established; do not invent counts
mediaArchitecture.dealPromotionalMedia: User-managed WordPress Media Library featured images; no seeded offers or source-controlled promotional artwork
mediaArchitecture.dealsLandingHeroMedia: Repository-owned, user-supplied media under wp-content/themes/empire-king/assets/images/deals-landing/; one naturally selected welcome-overlay background slot and a naturally ordered transparent PNG foreground collection; no generated imagery
